name: Discovery shows traceable Twente funding without overstating coverage
description: A student can search and filter a real scholarship, inspect its funding and official evidence, and distinguish partial funding from a full award.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /scholarships. In Search scholarships enter Twente. Set Destination to Netherlands and click Search.
Verify University of Twente Scholarship is in the results, then reload and verify the search input still contains Twente and Destination remains Netherlands.
Open the University of Twente Scholarship result.
Verify the scholarship title and Netherlands destination are displayed, with a partial funding label rather than a claim that this award covers every cost.
Find Evidence you can inspect. In the funding evidence, verify the official passage contains the award range € 3,000 - € 22,000 and an official utwente.nl source link.
Verify the source evidence includes its verification context and the page distinguishes the provider application window from personal application progress.
